spec.description: Option B of open question 1 in llm-dlc/loops/build-orchestration.md, settled by the user on 2026-11-05: result.json is now stored as format 2 (examples/tools/result_format.py, examples/schema/stored-result.schema.json). Each fact is stored once: the verdict as conclusion.status, the execution in attempt.execution, each obligation (B11 property, D1 configuration, generated operator's contract) with its own evidence, and everything else under evidence. Pages read it through the flat view, so they render as before. Before publishing, build.py checks that the result stored and read back is the same result; a run whose result would not store whole exits without publishing. The verdict must be as expected, the stored result must have format 2 with obligations of the expected kinds (none), and its flat view must carry the claim and attempt.
